post.summary: Advance a load to its next execution status (atomic: status + timeline + audit + outbox)

schema.description: Client-generated key, unique per user action. Replaying it returns the original outcome instead of applying twice (safe offline retry).

expected_status.description: The status the client believes the load is in. If it is not the current status the call fails with 409 VERSION_CONFLICT. Omit to advance from whatever the server holds.

new_status.description: Target execution status: scheduled, dispatched, picked_up, in_transit or delivered.

reason.description: Free-text note stored on the timeline entry.

occurred_at.description: When it actually happened (offline replays); defaults to now.
